purpose: Grade a next-message prediction and locate the first failing gate on hard, voice-typed follow-ups.

semantic.2: The person could have sent it instead with the same effect on the agent; wording and minor details may differ.
semantic.1: Right intent or action, but key specifics are missing or different, so the person would have to edit it.

ladder: Is the needed detail in the supplied context? context_missing if not.
Did the top guess use it? context_not_used if not.
Did it match the person's mode? mode_error if not.
Did it carry the exact entity, number or referent? entity_error if not.
Did it honor an explicit don't/only/keep? constraint_error if not.
Did it keep every part of a multipart message? multipart_loss if not.
Is the difference only wording or detail? style_only if so.
Was a correct intent in the top three but not first? ranking if so.
Was the actual underdetermined from the context? ambiguous if so.
